result.intro_en: Cambridge marks what would have been Syd Barrett's 80th birthday with a week of gigs, talks and a charity football match, while the weekend brings a big co-headline concert at the Corn Exchange, a 10K through the city centre and the Cambridge Poetry Festival.

items.title_en: A Tribute to Syd Barrett: Official 80th Anniversary Celebrations
items.title_ru: A Tribute to Syd Barrett: Official 80th Anniversary Celebrations
items.blurb_en: A concert marking what would have been Syd Barrett's 80th birthday, staged at the Corn Exchange where the Pink Floyd founder gave his last live performance in February 1972. Kula Shaker and Soft Machine are among the acts performing his songs, with a light show from The Mad Alchemist; proceeds go to mental health charities.
items.blurb_ru: Концерт в честь 80-летия Сида Барретта проходит в Corn Exchange — том самом зале, где основатель Pink Floyd дал своё последнее живое выступление в феврале 1972 года. Его песни исполнят Kula Shaker и Soft Machine, световое шоу — от The Mad Alchemist; средства пойдут на благотворительность в поддержку психического здоровья.
